author: styropyr0
description: The Ruby collector for Visionary. A Rack middleware (with a Railtie for Rails) writes one row per HTTP request, database and outbound HTTP spans, errors, deploy markers and periodic host/process samples to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite or Cloudflare D1, on background threads.

author: James Edwards-Jones
description: Serves the 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol without sessions: every request is answered on its own, so any instance behind a load balancer can take any call. Rack middleware, JSON-RPC errors, cursors and tool schemas, with Rails support in stateless-mcp-rails.

author: James Edwards-Jones
description: Rails support for stateless-mcp: a tool is a controller action, routed by the Mcp-Method and Mcp-Name headers of the 2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol, and tools/list is drawn from the routes.
